_enabled: Off. Turning it on is a captain decision made in a PR: the email ask is off by a recorded ruling (scripts/paid-status/daily.sh, firstmate 024), and `approval` below must name the decision that lifts it.

template_data.titles: the tracks you submitted on Muso

_template_data: The same data for every person, so the body is one set of bytes; the copy gate is asked on every job's bytes and an observed pass is a hold here. `titles` is words a customer reads: it is a proposal until the copy gate approves the rendered body.
_body: Filled from `bulk_asks.py pin --templates-dir <reviewed checkout>` in the PR that pins the template in policies/bulk-send-queue.json. Empty means nothing can be released.

ramp._bars: hard_bounce_max and complaint_max are the gateway's own pause bars (WARMUP_PAUSE_BOUNCE, WARMUP_PAUSE_COMPLAINT), stricter than the 2 percent in the lane's contract. health_lag_s is the gateway's 5 minute health cache. soft_bounce_max (twice the 4.96 percent the route measured on 2026-11-14) and rate_hold_s are this file's own choices and nobody has ruled on them.
